lines.en: label rinspring7:
scene sky
It’s a new day, which means there is a new night on the way. Then, once that happens, there will be another new day on the way and I can say this all again tomorrow.
lines.zh: 又是新的一天，也就是说又有一个新的夜晚在路上。而等它到来之后，又会有另一个新的一天在路上，明天我可以把这套话再说一遍。

lines.en: Then again the next. And again the next. Forever and ever and ever because there can be no end in sight when I’ve grown blind to the ticking of a clock that never does.
lines.zh: 然后后天再说一遍。大后天再说一遍。永永远远、没完没了，因为当我已经对一只从不走动的钟的滴答声视而不见时，就再也看不到任何尽头。

lines.en: Good morning. My name is Akira Arakawa, I’m 31 years old, and I’m ready to ruin somebody’s life and/or day.
lines.zh: 早上好。我叫 Akira Arakawa，今年 31 岁，已经准备好要毁掉某个人的一生、以及/或者一整天。

lines.en: Oh, look. And right on cue. There’s my latest victim now.
lines.zh: 哦，瞧。说来就来。我最新的受害者这就出现了。

lines.en: I tap a button on my phone and have a large penis. It’s so awesome being me.
lines.zh: 我在手机上按了个按钮，于是拥有了一根大阴茎。当我的感觉真棒。

lines.en: : Hello?
: {i}Hi! Guess who has her phone again?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}嗨！猜猜谁又拿回手机了？{/i}

lines.en: : Oh, cool. But also not cool because I kind of figured you’d have picked up right where you left off when Rika took yours away.
lines.zh: : 哦，不错。但也不太妙，因为我本来还以为 Rika 收走你手机之后，你会从断掉的地方直接接着来。

lines.en: : {i}You mean sending you nudes in the heat of a horny rampage and then begging for you to come ravage my body like a raptor plucking strips of meat off of a dying animal?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你是说在饥渴暴走的热头上一张张给你发裸照，然后求你过来像迅猛龙撕下垂死动物身上的肉条那样蹂躏我的身体？{/i}

lines.en: : What happened to the silverback gorilla thing?
lines.zh: : 那银背大猩猩那套呢？

lines.en: : {i}I learned their penises are really small. Such a shame, really. Having a figure like that and then just a toothpick down below? I’d probably snap it off the way I am now.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我查到它们的阴茎其实很小。真是太遗憾了。有着那么一副身材，下面却只挂了根牙签？照我现在的状态，大概会直接把它折断。{/i}

lines.en: : Are raptor penises larger?
lines.zh: : 迅猛龙的阴茎更大吗？

lines.en: : {i}I don’t know. I’m kind of scared to Google it. But that doesn’t matter because I’m NOT looking to have sex today!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}不知道。我有点不敢去谷歌。不过这不重要，因为我今天可不是来找你上床的！{/i}

lines.en: I hang up the phone. I don’t have time for this.
lines.zh: 我挂断了电话。我没空陪你闹。

lines.en: : Hello?
: {i}You hung up the phone! Don’t act like you’re only in this for my body after several years of mutual lusting! Come hang out!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你居然挂我电话！在互相馋了好几年之后，别装得你只对我的身体感兴趣似的！出来玩！{/i}

lines.en: : Wow, yeah. It sounds really fun spending the whole day wanting to have sex with each other and then not doing it.
lines.zh: : 哇，是啊。花一整天互相馋着对方、然后又什么都不做，听起来真有意思。

lines.en: : {i}Is that not what you do when you hang out with Miss Watabe and her girlfriend? Or any of the other girls you’re not having sex with because of reasons?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}你跟 Watabe 老师和她女朋友出去玩的时候不就是这样吗？还有那些你出于种种原因没在跟她们上床的女孩们？{/i}

lines.en: : I’m just messing with you, Rin. What do you want to do?
lines.zh: : 我逗你玩的，Rin。你想干什么？

lines.en: : {i}Mall! I have money now and I’m not afraid to use it!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}逛商场！我现在有钱了，而且我不怕花！{/i}

lines.en: : Oh, right. It just opened back up, didn’t it? Do you want to just meet there or something?
lines.zh: : 哦，对。它刚重新开业，是吧？你要不要干脆就在那儿碰头什么的？

lines.en: : {i}Yes, but only because I’m already here. Under normal circumstances, I’d meet you halfway. Today, you come to me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}要，但只是因为我已经在这儿了。正常情况下，我会走一半去接你。今天，你来找我。{/i}

lines.en: : I think you’re supposed to wait until making plans with someone to start fulfilling those plans, Rin.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你总该先跟人约好，再开始履行那个约定吧，Rin。

lines.en: : {i}I think you’re supposed to just do what I tell you because that’s what homies do.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我觉得你该乖乖照我说的做，因为老铁就该这样。{/i}

lines.en: : Does that work both ways?
lines.zh: : 这一条对双方都有效吗？

lines.en: : {i}Everything about me works both ways.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我身上的一切都对双方有效。{/i}

lines.en: : Then let’s make out later.
lines.zh: : 那待会儿接吻吧。

lines.en: : {i}Word. See you soon!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}一言为定。待会儿见！{/i}

lines.en: : See you soon...
lines.zh: : 待会儿见……

lines.en: scene black
I hang up the phone and...get dressed, I guess. And, for once, I have morning plans with Rin that {i}don’t{/i} involve me heading over to Koi Cafe first.
lines.zh: 我挂了电话，然后……大概就是穿衣服吧。而且，破天荒第一次，我和 Rin 的晨间计划里{i}不{/i}包括先跑去 Koi Cafe。

lines.en: It’s fine, though. I’ll just make her buy me coffee at the mall since she has money now and “isn’t afraid to use it.”
lines.zh: 不过没关系。反正她现在有钱了，又「不怕花钱」，我就让她在商场里给我买咖啡好了。

lines.en: I’m sure that she’ll feel very good about this and won’t feel like I’m leveraging my relationship with her to earn material goods at all?
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，她会对此感觉非常好，丝毫不会觉得我是在利用我和她的关系换取物质好处吧？

lines.en: Anyway, I’ll check back in an hour or so when I’m-
lines.zh: 总之，我大概一小时后再回来看看，那时候我——

lines.en: scene rinnewmall1
: Hey!
: Oh. I guess I’m already here.
lines.zh: : 哦。看来我已经到了。

lines.en: scene rinnewmall2
: Seems like pretty much everybody is. I haven’t seen the mall this busy since Black Ops 2 came out and I think I was only like 6 for that.
lines.zh: : 好像基本上所有人都到了。我还没见过商场这么热闹，自打 Black Ops 2 发售那会儿起，而那时候我大概才 6 岁吧。

lines.en: : Is that a movie or something?
lines.zh: : 那是电影什么的吗？

lines.en: scene rinnewmall3
: Are you sure you’re in your thirties, Sensei? Because you sure seem to say a lot of stuff that makes me question the legitimacy of that.
lines.zh: : 你确定自己三十多岁吗，Sensei？因为你确实说了不少让我怀疑这一点的东西。

lines.en: : I’m pretty sure just not having a social media account or any actual interests puts me a couple decades behind everyone.
lines.zh: : 我敢说，光是没有社交媒体账号、也没有任何真正的爱好，就让我比所有人落后了几十年。

lines.en: : Spares you the risk of getting cancelled at least. You’re like prime cancelling material too, so I doubt you’d last long anyway.
lines.zh: : 至少免了被「取消」的风险。而且你还属于头号被取消素材，所以我怀疑你根本撑不了多久。

lines.en: : What does that even mean? I’ve heard it before.
lines.zh: : 那到底是什么意思？我之前听过。

lines.en: : It’s basically when a bunch of people online decide that you suck and then nothing else happens and everyone goes on with their lives.
lines.zh: : 基本上就是网上一堆人认定你很差劲，然后什么也没发生，大家继续过自己的日子。

lines.en: : Oh. {i}That’s{/i} what people are afraid of nowadays?
lines.zh: : 哦。现在的人怕的{i}就是这个{/i}？

lines.en: : I don’t get it either. But, from what I understand, I’m much closer to a depiction of teenagers from your generation than I am from mine. Weird. I wonder why?
lines.zh: : 我也不懂。但据我所知，比起我这一代的青少年，我倒更接近你们这一代青少年被描绘出来的样子。奇怪。我倒想知道为什么？

lines.en: : I imagine you just take after your moms. They seemed to have been pretty influential given how you all really like girls.
lines.zh: : 我猜你大概是随了你那两位妈妈。看你们都那么喜欢女孩子，她们的影响力应该不小。

lines.en: : Did you just imply that my bisexuality is a choice or the result of my upbringing? I’m going to cancel you right here and now, dude. That’s it. You’re cancelled.
lines.zh: : 你刚刚是在暗示我的双性恋是一种选择、或者是我的成长环境造成的？我现在就要当场取消你，老兄。就这样。你被取消了。

lines.en: : I feel no different.
lines.zh: : 我感觉没什么不同。

lines.en: : But I bet a bunch of people {i}think{/i} you do. So...take that.
lines.zh: : 但我打赌有一堆人{i}觉得{/i}你不一样了。所以……接招吧。

lines.en: : Right, yeah. So how much more of this until we get to the making out part?
lines.zh: : 对，是啊。那还要再聊多久才到接吻环节？

lines.en: : We could make out right now if you don’t mind a bunch of weird older guys who smell vaguely like chlorine watching us?
lines.zh: : 要是你不介意一群闻起来隐约有氯气味儿的怪老头盯着我们看，我们现在就能接吻。

lines.en: : Oh, good. So I’m not the only one who smells that. I’m glad I’m not having a stroke.
lines.zh: : 哦，还好。原来不只我一个人闻到。真高兴我不是中风了。

lines.en: : I thought toast was the stroke smell?
lines.zh: : 我以为中风的先兆气味是烤面包？

lines.en: : Then we’re in trouble because I smell that too.
lines.zh: : 那我们就麻烦了，因为我也闻到了那个。

lines.en: : That’s probably just the new bakery that opened up. There was an older guy in there who kept screaming about corn flakes, so I think they’re just trying to figure out how to make them?
lines.zh: : 那大概是新开的那家面包店。里面有个老头一直在喊玉米片什么的，所以我猜他们只是在研究怎么做玉米片？

lines.en: : I don’t think they’re doing it correctly.
lines.zh: : 我觉得他们做得不太对。

lines.en: : I don’t think they’re doing {i}anything{/i} correctly because I ordered a scone and wound up with grilled squid instead. Probably just misheard me. Opening day woes, you know?
lines.zh: : 我觉得他们{i}什么事{/i}都做得不太对，因为我点了个司康，结果端上来的是烤鱿鱼。大概是听错了。开业当天的毛病嘛，你知道的。

lines.en: : There’s a pretty drastic difference in the pronunciation of those words, Rin.
lines.zh: : Rin，这两个词的发音差别可是相当大啊。

lines.en: : It’s much less drastic in English. And, for all we know, there are a bunch of people watching us through a screen right now where our dialogue is translated into that.
lines.zh: : 用英语说差别就没那么大了。而且说不定，现在正有一群人隔着屏幕看着我们，而我们的对话正被翻译成那个。

lines.en: : Well, I hope they don’t watch {i}everything{/i} because it’s going to be hard surviving cancellation after making out with a teenager later.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我希望他们别{i}什么都{/i}看，毕竟待会儿跟一个未成年少女接吻之后，要挺过「取消」可就难了。

lines.en: scene rinnewmall4
: {i}I’ll{/i} be fine, at least. You can get away with all sorts of stuff by being a cute girl. It’s about time I went viral, you know.
lines.zh: : 至少{i}我会{/i}没事。当个可爱女孩，什么都能蒙混过去。我也该火一把了，你说呢。

lines.en: scene rinnewmall5
: However! There is more exploring to do before our tongues wind up in each other’s mouths! And {i}I{/i} still need to go pick up the latest Days to Waste album, so you’re coming with me!
lines.zh: : 不过！在咱们的舌头钻进对方嘴里之前，还有更多地方要逛！而且{i}我{/i}还得去拿 Days to Waste 的最新专辑，所以你得陪我去！

lines.en: : Can I at least get my coffee first?
lines.zh: : 我至少能先买杯咖啡吧？

lines.en: : Only the bakery has coffee right now and {i}I{/i} don’t want to be around the corn flakes guy so {i}you’re{/i} going to have to wait! To the music shop! Away!
lines.zh: : 现在只有那家面包店有咖啡，而{i}我{/i}不想待在玉米片老头旁边，所以{i}你{/i}得等着！去唱片店！冲啊！

lines.en: scene rinnewmall6
: Corn flakes!
lines.zh: : 玉米片！

lines.en: : Now, now dear. We already {i}got{/i} your corn flakes. We’re {i}here{/i} for the latest Days to Waste album. Remember?
lines.zh: : 好啦好啦，亲爱的。玉米片我们已经给你{i}买了{/i}。我们是{i}来{/i}拿 Days to Waste 最新专辑的。记得吗？

lines.en: : Forget me when the summer ends!
lines.zh: : 夏天结束就把我忘了吧！

lines.en: : There is no escape. The new mall is cursed.
lines.zh: : 无处可逃。新商场被诅咒了。

lines.en: : Hey, those old people listen to the same music as you. You’re suddenly way less cool than I thought you were.
lines.zh: : 嘿，那些老头听的歌跟你一样。你突然就没我想的那么酷了。

lines.en: scene rinnewmall7
: I’m surprised you ever thought I was cool in the first place. I don’t have any rings on and that’s the key indicator of that.
lines.zh: : 我倒惊讶你一开始居然觉得我酷。我身上一枚戒指都没有，那可是关键指标。

lines.en: : You have earrings. They’re just normally obscured by your hair. So it’s sort of like there’s been a hint of coolness just looming in the background that is now gone because of old people.
lines.zh: : 你有耳环啊。只是平时被头发遮住了。所以就像是一直有一丝酷在背景里若隐若现，而现在被那些老头给毁了。

lines.en: : Why do old people always have to ruin everything? Why can’t they just leave us alone and not listen to our music or take our cell phones away because we’re trying to sext adults?
lines.zh: : 为什么老人家总是要毁掉一切？他们为什么就不能别管我们，别听我们的音乐，别因为我们想跟成年人发色情短信就没收我们的手机？

lines.en: : I think lumping your mom in with other old people is a little unfair to her when she’s the same age as you mentally.
lines.zh: : 我觉得把你妈跟其他老人混为一谈对她有点不公平，毕竟她心理年龄跟你一样大。

lines.en: scene rinnewmall8
: True. But she’s seemed weirdly positive lately if you take away all the stuff about me liking you. I wonder if she finally met somebody?
lines.zh: : 有道理。不过如果把「我喜欢你」那部分拿掉，她最近看起来出奇地积极。我在想她是不是终于遇到什么人了？

lines.en: : Not a clue. I have nothing to do with this or her and don’t know anything about that.
lines.zh: : 一无所知。这事儿和我、和她都毫无关系，我什么都不知道。

lines.en: : That’s good. Because if I found out she wound up sleeping with {i}you{/i} or something-
lines.zh: : 那就好。因为要是我发现她最后跟{i}你{/i}上了床什么的——

lines.en: scene rinnewmall9
: OH MY GOD!
lines.zh: : 我的天啊！

lines.en: scene rinnewmall10
: I can’t believe you slept with my mom! Even {i}if{/i} I told you to sleep with my mom! That was so long ago! You were supposed to forget about it!
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信你跟我妈上过床！{i}就算{/i}是我叫你去跟我妈上床的！那都多久以前的事了！你本来该忘掉的！

lines.en: : In my defense, she was extremely drunk.
lines.zh: : 替我自己辩护一句，她当时醉得厉害。

lines.en: : I don’t think you know what “defense” means!
lines.zh: : 我觉得你根本不知道「辩护」是什么意思！

lines.en: scene rinnewmall11
: Also, why did they give us squid {i}again?!{/i} All we asked for was coffee this time! There’s no way they misheard that too!
lines.zh: : 还有，他们为什么{i}又{/i}给了我们鱿鱼？！这次我们明明只点了咖啡！这不可能也听错了吧！

lines.en: : Rin, I’m sorry about the whole...sleeping with your mom thing. But, on the bright side, I have no problems with you calling me “Daddy” from now on.
lines.zh: : Rin，关于那个……跟你妈上床的事，我很抱歉。不过往好处想，从现在起你叫我「爸爸」我都没意见。

lines.en: scene rinnewmall12
: She’s so {i}old,{/i} though. Like, how did you even do it without breaking her hip or something?
lines.zh: : 可她那么{i}老{/i}了啊。就比如，你是怎么做到的，居然没把她胯骨弄折什么的？

lines.en: : Oh, easy. She was on top and got to control the pace.
lines.zh: : 哦，简单。她在上面，节奏由她控制。

lines.en: scene rinnewmall10
: Be more vague! I didn’t ask for {i}specifics!{/i}
lines.zh: : 说得更含糊点！我可没问{i}细节！{/i}

lines.en: : At least the first time. The second, I got to be the one in charge.
lines.zh: : 至少第一次是这样。第二次，换我主导了。

lines.en: : There was a {i}second?!{/i}
lines.zh: : 还有{i}第二次{/i}？！

lines.en: : A third and fourth and fifth too, yeah. I don’t know if you’d count those ones, though, since Imani was there too.
lines.zh: : 第三次、第四次、第五次也有，是啊。不过那几次不知道算不算，因为 Imani 也在。

lines.en: : That’s-
scene rinnewmall13
: Actually, that’s kind of hot. Very hot. Miss Imai is so pretty. It should have been me there in place of my mom.
lines.zh: : 其实，那还挺带感的。非常带感。Imai 老师那么漂亮。该跟我妈躺在那儿的人是我才对。

lines.en: : Yeah, I think Imani’s a little less enthusiastic about having sex with teenagers than I am.
lines.zh: : 嗯，我觉得 Imani 对跟未成年人上床的热情可没我这么高。

lines.en: : I kind of figured based simply on the fact that she hasn’t hooked up with Kirin yet despite having over a thousand opportunities to do just that.
lines.zh: : 我早就猜到了，光看她明明有一千多次机会，却到现在都没跟 Kirin 搞上就知道了。

lines.en: : What does this mean for the future, though? Like, was it just a one or...I guess a {i}two{/i} night stand thing? You’re not going to keep doing it are you? That could impact our friendship.
lines.zh: : 不过这对未来意味着什么？就是，那只是一夜情，还是……我猜算是{i}两{/i}夜情？你不会打算继续下去吧？那可能会影响我们的友情。

lines.en: : Could it?
lines.zh: : 会吗？

lines.en: : I mean, yeah. Like, she obviously doesn’t want me seeing you. So if we’re {i}both{/i} seeing you, things could get even messier.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，会啊。比如，她显然不希望我见你。所以要是我们{i}两个人{/i}都在跟你交往，事情只会更乱。

lines.en: : I might even lose my laptop next time. And if I lose my laptop, that means no more porn. And if I lose access to porn, that means I’ll need to use {i}Futaba’s{/i} laptop for porn.
lines.zh: : 下次我可能连笔记本电脑都要没了。而要是没了笔记本，就意味着没有片子看。而要是没有片子看，我就得用 {i}Futaba 的{/i}笔记本看片。

lines.en: : {size=-5}And if I use {i}Futaba’s{/i} laptop for porn, she’ll find a bunch of lesbian stuff in her history, accidentally click on something, and begin the slow and painful conversion into lesbianism, thus destroying the entire space time continuum and life as we know it.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-5}而我要是用了 {i}Futaba 的{/i}笔记本看片，她就会在历史记录里发现一堆女同的东西，不小心点开什么，然后开始缓慢而痛苦地被转化成女同，进而摧毁整个时空连续体，以及我们所知的整个生命世界。{/size}

lines.en: : So if I keep having sex with your mom, it will destroy the universe?
lines.zh: : 所以要是我继续跟你妈上床，就会毁灭宇宙？

lines.en: : Basically, yeah.
lines.zh: : 基本上，是的。

lines.en: : Wow. I’ll be sure to keep that in mind the next time I’m having sex with your mom.
lines.zh: : 哇。下次我跟你妈上床的时候，一定会记住这一点。

lines.en: scene rinnewmall14
: Please do. That’s all I-
lines.zh: : 请务必记住。我只——

lines.en: scene rinnewmall15
: Wait a second! Would you seriously destroy the space time continuum for sex with some old lady?!   Shouldn’t you be a little more careful, maybe?!
lines.zh: : 等等！你为了跟某个老女人上床，还真要毁掉时空连续体吗？！  你就不能稍微谨慎一点吗？！

lines.en: : Destroying the space time continuum would actually be a huge plus for me. So if boning Rika is the key to solving the mysteries of the universe, I will bone her as many times as it takes.
lines.zh: : 毁掉时空连续体对我来说其实是巨大的加分项。所以如果干 Rika 是解开宇宙奥秘的关键，那需要干多少次我就干多少次。

lines.en: scene rinnewmall16
: God damn it. I can’t believe I’m going to eventually sleep with the same guy as my mom. I’ve seen so many videos with this same exact plot line before.
lines.zh: : 该死。我真不敢相信自己最后居然要跟和我妈上过床的同一个男人上床。这种剧情我看过的视频里演过不知道多少遍了。

lines.en: : Thanks for not getting mad at me. Even if the lack of anger is the direct result of having sex with so many other people that you care about.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你没有生我的气。哪怕这份不生气，直接来源于你也在跟那么多你在乎的人上床。

lines.en: : Yeah, the Chika thing was honestly way worse than this. But the Chika thing is a whole {i}other{/i} thing lately and now I’m just kind of burnt out.
lines.zh: : 是啊，Chika 那件事说实话比这个糟糕多了。但 Chika 那件事最近已经完全是{i}另一{/i}回事了，我现在有点被耗干了。

lines.en: : A whole “other” thing as in what, exactly? Because I will also agree that she is crazy now and this may or may not be my fault.
lines.zh: : 你说的完全是「另一」回事，具体是指什么？因为我也同意她现在有点疯，而这可能是、也可能不是我的错。

lines.en: scene rinnewmall17
: I don’t think you have much to do with this apart from just {i}me{/i} also liking you, really. We’re just...going through a bit of a...{i}spat{/i} right now.
lines.zh: : {i}我{/i}觉得除了我也喜欢你之外，这跟你真没多大关系。我们只是……现在正在闹点……{i}小别扭{/i}。

lines.en: : Well, is it anything I can help with? Because Chika still listens to me to a...certain extent. And I can promise you I won’t have sex with her in order to extract information by sensual force.
lines.zh: : 那有什么我能帮上忙的吗？因为 Chika 在……某种程度上还是听我的。而且我可以保证，我不会为了用感官手段逼问情报就去跟她上床。

lines.en: : At this rate, {i}I{/i} might have to extract information from her by sensual force. Whatever “sensual force” means.
lines.zh: : 照这个势头下去，{i}我{/i}可能真得用感官手段从她那儿逼问情报了。管它「感官手段」是什么意思。

lines.en: : Now {i}that{/i} I would like to see.
lines.zh: : {i}那个{/i}我倒真想看看。

lines.en: scene rinnewmall18
: Would you really, though?
lines.zh: : 你真想看吗？

lines.en: : Because I know it’s easy to say that, but I {i}also{/i} know it was probably hell watching me get invested in other people when you knew way before me that we were a little {i}more{/i} than just friends.
lines.zh: : 因为我知道说起来容易，可我{i}也{/i}知道，当你明明比我早得多就知道我们{i}不止{/i}是朋友，却看着我投入别人的怀抱时，那大概像地狱一样难受。

lines.en: : I’m not going to fault you for trying to date girls your age, Rin. Nor am I going to fault you for taking so long to get on the same page as me.
lines.zh: : 我不会因为你试着跟你同龄的女孩交往而怪你，Rin。也不会因为你花了那么久才跟我站到同一页上而怪你。

lines.en: : And yes, I would probably be upset if I had to share you. And yes, I acknowledge that it’s entirely unreasonable for me to expect you to reject the same infidelity that I partake in daily.
lines.zh: : 而且是的，如果要分享你，我大概会难过。是的，我也承认，指望你拒绝我每天都在犯的那种不忠，本身就完全不讲道理。

lines.en: : {i}However...{/i}if you strapped me to a chair and forced me to watch you and Chika lez out on each other, my arousal would be undeniable. Sad, yes. But undeniable.
lines.zh: : {i}不过……{/i}要是你把我绑在椅子上，逼我看你和 Chika 互相搞蕾丝，我的兴奋是无可否认的。是很可悲，没错。但无可否认。

lines.en: : Kind of like how I felt watching you and Sana from behind the curtain at Ayane’s place.
lines.zh: : 就像我在 Ayane 家的帘子后面看着你和 Sana 时那样。

lines.en: : Oh, right. I forgot that happened.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。我都忘了那件事了。

lines.en: scene rinnewmall19
: It’s fine, Sensei. I shouldn’t be relying on other people to solve my problems for me. This is something I can handle on my own.
lines.zh: : 没关系的，Sensei。我本来就不该指望别人替我解决问题。这件事我自己能处理。

lines.en: : {size=-2}True. But if I am loosely involved as you claim due to the fact that you also like me now, we can find a way to leverage that and potentially provide you the opportunity to act on it and confront your issues with Chika.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}没错。但既然按你的说法，因为你现在也喜欢我，我也算多少有点牵扯，那我们就可以想想办法利用这一点，说不定能给你一个机会，让你顺着心意去做，同时直面你和 Chika 之间的问题。{/size}

lines.en: : What, like...have her see us together and then get offended by my forwardness?
lines.zh: : 什么，比如……让她看到我们在一起，然后被我的主动冒犯到？

lines.en: : Basically, yeah.
lines.zh: : 基本上，是的。

lines.en: : You think that would work?
lines.zh: : 你觉得那能行？

lines.en: : I don’t think it {i}wouldn’t{/i} work?
lines.zh: : 我不觉得它{i}不{/i}行？
